heading: Earthnuts or Pignuts

receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt in 'Acetaria: A Discourse of Sallets' by John Evelyn (Evelyn 1699)
receipts.receiptText: Earth-Nuts, Bulbo-Castanum; (found in divers places of Surry, near Kingston, and other parts) the Rind par'd off, are eaten crude by Rustics, with a little Pepper; but are best boil'd like other Roots, or in Pottage rather, and are sweet and nourishing.

synonym: , kippernut, cipernut, arnut, jarnut, hawknut, earth chestnut, groundnut, earthnut, pignut, hognut, Saint Anthony's nut
title: Earthnuts or Pignuts
